{"sections":[{"text":"在给定材料中，与“实验配置和性能结果”最相关的是 SPAD 论文；其摘要说明该工作面向分离式 LLM 推理，分别设计 Prefill 芯片与 Decode 芯片，并报告了相对建模 H100 的仿真结果。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"This paper proposes SPAD (Specialized Prefill and Decode hardware), adopting a less-is-more methodology to design specialized chips tailored to the distinct characteristics of prefill and decode phases."},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Compared to modeled H100s, simulations show that the proposed Prefill Chips deliver 8% higher prefill performance on average at 52% lower hardware cost, while the proposed Decode Chips achieve 97% of the decode performance with 28% lower TDP."}]},{"text":"实验模型配置方面，材料列出三个开源模型：BLOOM-176B 使用 FP16 与张量并行 8；Llama3-70B 使用 FP16 与张量并行 4；DeepSeek-V2-236B 使用 FP8 与专家并行 8。","sources":[{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c6","quote":"① BLOOM-176B [54] uses Multi-Head Attention [62] and we deployed it with FP16 and a tensor parallelism of 8 (TP=8)."},{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c6","quote":"② Llama3-70B [25] uses Grouped-Query Attention [6] with smaller KV cache footprints, and we deployed it with FP16 and TP=4."},{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c6","quote":"③ DeepSeek-V2-236B [19] uses DeepSeekMoE [17] with Multi-head Latent Attention to compress the KV cache, and we deployed it with FP8 and expert parallelism 8 (EP=8)."}]},{"text":"工作负载使用来自微软的开源请求轨迹，代表 coding（代码补全）和 conversation（聊天机器人）两类应用；端到端评估同时包含硬件架构仿真和集群级调度仿真。","sources":[{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c6","quote":"We use open-source request traces from Mi-
crosoft [12], representing two common LLM applications:
coding(code completion) andconversation(chatbot)."},{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c4","quote":"We perform end-to-end evaluations that include both hard-
ware architectural simulation and cluster-level scheduling
simulation with workload traces to estimate how our designs
translate into performance and cost improvements at scale."}]},{"text":"调度仿真配置了两种方式：SplitwiseSim 用于分离式调度（Splitwise），Vidur 用于共置调度（Sarathi）；每次迭代的请求批次输入 LLMCompass 以估计单次迭代耗时。","sources":[{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c4","quote":"We explore two such scheduling approaches:
SplitwiseSim [51] as an implementation for disaggregated
scheduling (Splitwise), and Vidur [3] as an implementation
for co-location-based scheduling (Sarathi [4])."},{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c4","quote":"At each iteration, cluster simulators make scheduling deci-
sions to assign requests to machines, and these iteration-level
request batches are fed into LLMCompass [71] to estimate
how long it will take each machine to finish one iteration
for the request batch scheduled upon it."}]},{"text":"硬件成本与 TDP 建模方面，材料说明 H100 的 TDP 为 700 W，并假设 10% 的 TDP 开销；每个 HBM 封装功耗假设为 30 W，据此推算 H100 裸片（不含 HBM）TDP 为 480 W，并假设所提 Prefill/Decode 芯片与 H100 裸片具有相同功率密度。","sources":[{"source_id":"passage:paper-012:p9:c3","quote":"The H100
